en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 to stay until at least 6pm as Saudel edges nearer
en.dek: The Observatory said Tropical Depression Saudel remains over the northern South China Sea and that the signal issued on Monday evening will stay in force through this afternoon.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said Standby Signal No. 1, issued at 6.10pm on Monday as the remnant of Typhoon Saudel re-intensified into a tropical depression, would remain in force until at least 6pm on Tuesday.

Earlier bulletins had indicated the signal would last until at least noon. The Observatory said that, because of terrain sheltering, the chance of strong winds generally over the territory during the day was not high, but local winds were expected to pick up as Saudel moved closer to the coast of eastern Guangdong from this afternoon into Wednesday.

Saudel was tracking east or east-northeast across the northern South China Sea. The Observatory said it would assess whether Strong Wind Signal No. 3 was needed later, depending on the depression's intensity, the distance of its strong-wind area from the Pearl River Estuary, and changes in local winds.

The forecast for Tuesday was mainly cloudy with occasional squally showers and thunderstorms, heavier in some areas, temperatures of about 26 to 30 degrees, and swells. The Observatory advised the public to check the latest weather before heading out for school or work.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號至少維持至下午六時 沙德爾靠近粵東沿岸
zh.dek: 天文台表示，熱帶低氣壓沙德爾仍在南海北部移動，昨晚發出的一號戒備信號會至少維持至今日下午六時。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號會至少維持至星期二下午六時。該信號於星期一傍晚六時十分發出，當時颱風沙德爾的殘餘在海南島東南沿岸海域再度增強為熱帶低氣壓。
較早前的通報指信號至少維持至中午十二時。天文台解釋，受地形屏蔽，今日日間本港普遍吹強風的機會不大，但隨著沙德爾今日下午至星期三靠近廣東東部沿岸並逐漸增強，預料本港風力會逐步上升。
沙德爾現正向東或東北偏東移動，橫過南海北部。天文台會視乎其強度、相關強風區與珠江口的距離，以及本地風力變化，評估稍後是否需要改發三號強風信號。
天文台預測今日大致多雲，間中有狂風驟雨及雷暴，部分地區雨勢較大，氣溫約二十六至三十度，海有湧浪，並呼籲市民出門上學上班前留意最新天氣消息。
